dataIdInfo.idPurp: To provide a comprehensive municipal-scale representation of population structure, household composition, and socio-economic conditions enabling socially explicit flood risk and evacuation modeling.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: This dataset represents official Austrian municipal boundaries (LAU level, 2025) enriched with socio-economic, demographic, household, education, employment, and commuting attributes derived from national statistical sources. It constitutes the core social dataset used for social vulnerability, household dependency, and evacuation capacity analysis under HQ30 and HQ100 flood scenarios.

dataExt.exDesc: Local Administrative Unit (Gemeinde / LAU / L5) Municipal boundary geometry was joined with NTUS statistical tables using the unique municipality identifier (g_id). All joins were attribute-based; no geometric modification, resampling, or generalization was applied.

themeKeys.keyword: Local_SVI, HH_Vuln, Vert_Exp, social vulnerability, evacuation, Austria

enttyp.enttypd: Each entity represents a spatial feature (polygon) describing administrative units used in socially explicit flood risk assessment.
enttyp.enttypds: Author-defined, based on analytical purpose and processing logic of this study, following ISO 19115 metadata guidance and ArcGIS Pro documentation standards.

attr.attrdef: Municipality ID: A unique identification code for each Austrian municipality used as the primary join key.

attrdomv.udom: Sequential unique whole numbers that are automatically generated.

attr.attrdef: Municipality Name: The official name of the administrative unit (e.g., Eisenstadt, Rust).
Juvenile Population (Ages 0–14): The total number of children and adolescents within the municipality.
attr.attrdefs: Represents a "High-Intensity Care" group with cognitive and mobility limitations during evacuation.

attr.attrdef: Elderly Population (Ages 65+): The total number of senior residents within the municipality.
attr.attrdefs: Defined as the highest care-intensity group, often requiring specialized medical transport.

attr.attrdef: Unemployed Population: The total number of residents currently out of work
attr.attrdefs: Financial capital is the primary determinant of "bouncing back" and funding immediate post-disaster repairs.

attr.attrdef: Educational Attainment: Number of residents who have completed specific levels of higher education.
attr.attrdefs: Reflects "Administrative Resilience"—the capacity to navigate bureaucracy for insurance and aid.

attr.attrdef: Outward Commuters: The number of residents who travel outside the municipality for employment.
attr.attrdefs: Measures "Separation Risk"—the absence of able-bodied workforce during daytime disaster events.

attr.attrdef: Total Households: The total number of domestic units/residential households in the municipality.
attr.attrdefs: Used to normalize care burdens by determining the average density per family unit.

attr.attrdef: Building Count: The total number of physical residential structures.
attr.attrdefs: Essential for identifying building density and vertical vs. horizontal exposure.

attr.attrdef: Local Social Vulnerability Index: A composite score weighted by unemployment (50%), education (30%), and commuting (20%).
attr.attrdefs: Focuses on internal recovery mechanisms and structural pressures of daily mobility.
